summary: 0.2.3 improves PG wire targeting on CEE equipment and keeps test fixtures out of the gameplay jar. API 1.0.0 and existing saves stay compatible.
changes: Connect PG wires to exposed voltage-regulator posts, stacked regulator terminals and tiny capacitor pins using their native selection bounds.
Keep all GameTests and fixtures in a separate test companion, with gameplay code and native solver provenance retained in the mod jar.
Preserve wire reach and obstruction rules, electrical settings, native solver binaries and all 16 substeps.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.231 or 21.1.248, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
